preset.text: Every turn, you will choose whether to hit or stay. HIT means you will get dealt another card from the deck. STAY means you want to sit out for the rest of the round.

Every time you choose to hit, the number on the card you draw gets added to your score.

However, if you ever draw a card that you already have, you bust and you lose all your points from the round.
